source: {0} and {1} are shorthands for {2} and {3}. The latter is experimental and implemented with Vite alone: with {4} it produces a static SPA, and with SSR enabled it builds a server from the Nuxt SSR renderer whose entry exports a web-standard {5} ({6} serves the static output in front of it, and {7} runs it). Every dependency is bundled into that output, so it deploys without {8}. {9} crawls that server at the end of the build and writes a static {10}. It ships no server runtime, so server routes, route rules other than {11}, inlined styles and server components are unavailable, and modules that need a server will not work.

Toutes les dépendances sont incluses dans le bundle de cette sortie, ce qui permet de la déployer sans {8}. {9} explore ce serveur à la fin du build et écrit un {10} statique. Il ne fournit aucun runtime serveur : les routes serveur, les règles de route autres que {11}, les styles inlinés et les composants serveur sont donc indisponibles, et les modules qui nécessitent un serveur ne fonctionneront pas.
